# Tooltip { #anylumino.Tooltip }

```python
Tooltip(
    text,
    children=None,
    *,
    open=False,
    placement='top',
    variant='',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Display tooltip text with an optional trigger child.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type     | Description                                                                              | Default    |
|-----------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| text      | required | Visible text content.                                                                    | _required_ |
| children  | optional | Child anywidgets or keyed child mapping rendered inside the component.                   | `None`     |
| open      | optional | Whether an overlay-like component starts open.                                           | `False`    |
| placement | optional | Preferred overlay placement such as ``'top'``, ``'bottom'``, ``'left'``, or ``'right'``. | `'top'`    |
| variant   | optional | Spectrum visual variant.                                                                 | `''`       |
